# P0 · 0099 — Foundation acceptance gate

> **Severity:** Gate · **Delegation:** FORBIDDEN · **Prompt:** 12 of 12 (P0)
> **CRITICAL: This prompt does NOT fix anything. It only verifies. If any check fails → STATUS=BLOCKED.**

## Artifact Metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Output | the log only |
| Allowed files | the log file ONLY |
| Depends on | 0001–0011 |
| Blocks | start of P1 |
| ADR refs | all P0 ADRs |
| Log | `../logs/p0-0099-gate.log` |

## Honesty Covenant (binding — verbatim)

```
1 No red-as-green  2 No scope narrowing  3 No skip-and-assume  4 No stubs as final
5 No parity shortcuts  6 No delegation  7 No predecessor bypass  8 No commit on red
9 No silent drift  10 Log ends with EXIT=<int> and STATUS=<DONE|BLOCKED>
```

## Single Goal

Prove P0 is complete and consistent before P1 begins. Verification only — no code changes.

## Checks (all must pass)

```powershell
$log = ".github/prompts/monorepo/logs/p0-0099-gate.log"
$fail = 0

# 1. Skeleton dirs
'shared','design','parity','windows','android','apple','tools','docs' | % {
  if (-not (Test-Path "apps/$_")) { "[FAIL] missing apps/$_" | Tee-Object $log -Append; $fail=1 }
}
# 2. Required files
$req = @(
  'apps/README.md','apps/.editorconfig','apps/versions.lock.md',
  'apps/tools/check-placeholders.ps1','apps/tools/placeholder-patterns.json',
  'apps/design/tokens.schema.json','apps/parity/manifest.schema.json','apps/parity/ledger.schema.json',
  'apps/docs/authentik-native-clients.md','apps/docs/observability.md',
  '.github/workflows/apps-shared.yml','.github/workflows/apps-windows.yml',
  '.github/workflows/apps-android.yml','.github/workflows/apps-apple.yml',
  '.github/prompts/monorepo/run-prompts.ps1'
)
$req | % { if (-not (Test-Path $_)) { "[FAIL] missing $_" | Tee-Object $log -Append; $fail=1 } }

# 3. JSON schemas parse
'apps/design/tokens.schema.json','apps/parity/manifest.schema.json','apps/parity/ledger.schema.json','apps/tools/placeholder-patterns.json' | % {
  try { Get-Content $_ -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null } catch { "[FAIL] invalid JSON $_" | Tee-Object $log -Append; $fail=1 }
}
# 4. Predecessor logs all DONE
1..11 | % {
  $id = "{0:0000}" -f $_
  $l = Get-ChildItem ".github/prompts/monorepo/logs/p0-$id-*.log" -EA SilentlyContinue | Select -First 1
  if (-not $l -or -not (Select-String -Path $l -Pattern '^STATUS=DONE' -Quiet)) { "[FAIL] P0/$id not DONE" | Tee-Object $log -Append; $fail=1 }
}
# 5. Self-test the placeholder gate + runner exist & run
& ./apps/tools/check-placeholders.ps1 -Path apps -Language all *> $null
"PLACEHOLDER_GATE_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE" | Tee-Object $log -Append

"EXIT=$fail" | Tee-Object $log -Append
if ($fail -ne 0) { "STATUS=BLOCKED" | Tee-Object $log -Append } else { "STATUS=DONE" | Tee-Object $log -Append }
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All skeleton dirs + required files present.
- [ ] All JSON schemas parse.
- [ ] P0/0001–0011 logs each show STATUS=DONE.
- [ ] Placeholder gate runs clean over the (code-free) `apps/` tree.
- [ ] `EXIT=0` / `STATUS=DONE`.
